dependency_evidence: The merged change addresses the same unbounded-recursion pattern in two distinct framed stream parsers: FramedLZ4CompressorInputStream.nextBlock() and FramedSnappyCompressorInputStream.readNextBlock(). Each parser's handling of legal zero-output frames/chunks interacts with iteration over the outer framed stream; both source files and both regression-test classes are changed.
contamination_risk_reason: The exact PR and fixing revision are publicly accessible from August 2026, after the Qwen2.5 model-family release; however, the exact training-data collection cutoff is not established here, so exposure cannot be ruled out.
exclusion_reason: SCREENING-PENDING, not a permanent exclusion: build the structured case/CCDG, independently verify the pre-fix and post-fix regression behavior, then complete IC6/IC7 review before any pilot/main inclusion.
